description: When source files fail to parse or imports are unresolvable, return a partial graph plus a `Warnings[]` list of `{file, kind, message}` entries. Hard fail only on catastrophic project errors (missing `go.mod`, unreadable path). Mid-migration scenarios are first-class inputs.

requirements.description: When source files fail to parse or imports are unresolvable, Extract must return the partial graph built from successfully processed files/packages along with a Warnings[] list. Each warning entry must be a structured object with fields: file (string), kind (enum: PARSE_ERROR | UNRESOLVABLE_IMPORT | MISSING_TYPE_INFO), and message (string). Hard failures must only occur for catastrophic project-level errors: missing go.mod, unreadable scenario_path, or complete package load failure. Mid-migration scenarios with broken imports or partially valid files are explicitly first-class inputs and must not hard-fail.
requirements.title: Partial Graph Return with Structured Warnings on Parse Failures

validation.notes: Test that a module with one unparseable file returns a partial graph containing all other files' nodes and a Warnings[] entry for the failed file
Test that unresolvable imports produce a UNRESOLVABLE_IMPORT warning entry with the file and import path in the message
Test that missing go.mod produces a hard failure (not a warning)
Test that an unreadable scenario_path produces a hard failure (not a warning)
Test Warning struct serialization: file, kind, message fields all present and correctly typed
Table-driven tests for each warning kind with varied input states
Extract on a fixture with intentional syntax errors returns partial graph plus at least one PARSE_ERROR warning
Extract on a fixture with missing imported packages returns partial graph plus at least one UNRESOLVABLE_IMPORT warning
Extract on a fixture with no go.mod returns a hard-fail error response, not a partial graph
Extract on a mid-migration fixture (mixed valid/broken files) returns nodes for all valid files
Consumers can distinguish between hard failures and partial-success responses via response type, not by inspecting error strings
Mid-migration codebases that are standard Vrooli migration inputs do not cause full extraction failures

title: Partial Graph + Structured Warnings
